newsitem.title: JAPAN: TENNIS-FRANCE SURVIVE GRUELLING TEST AGAINST JAPAN.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-FRANCE SURVIVE GRUELLING TEST AGAINST JAPAN.

text.p: France took an unbeatable 3-1 lead against Japan in their Fed Cup world group one tie on Sunday, but not until after two marathon matches and a surprise loss by top player Mary Pierce.
After comfortably winning both singles rubbers on Saturday, Pierce and Nathalie Tauziat spent over seven hours on court in two epic reverse singles matches.
Ai Sugiyama, world ranked 29 and Japan's number one, upset Australian Open finalist Pierce 7-5 6-7 6-4 in a three hour and 10 minute contest.
Pierce, ranked 12 in the world, forced Sugiyama to a tie break in the second set as the Japanese players showed some nervousness but she seemed to tire in the third as the match dragged on.
Tauziat's match lasted even longer, taking four hours and five minutes to beat Naoko Sawamatsu 7-5 4-6 17-15.
